issues.summary: Eighteen PlayerGroupLoop alliance calls across 24 RO maps remain opaque or unresolved after the safe resolver expanded 182 concrete edges.
issues.impact: The adapter now exposes the statically concrete subset while retaining 18 unresolved calls as unavailable targets; it will not infer allies or enemies from opaque values.
issues.nextAction: Capture native owner/alliance/action evidence for the unresolved calls before widening the target contract.

issues.summary: thorner03 P2 is statically a time-gated scripted ally, but the latest admissible debug-free native run lost Tychus before Region 24 and never reached the map-owned RescueUnit handover.
issues.impact: P2-owned units, P1-visible allied units, and an acknowledged native P2 command are not authorized for the adapter in the absence of the handover window.
issues.nextAction: Reach Region 24 through supported mission gameplay, or keep the map-specific P2 command contract unavailable.

issues.summary: A historical Stage 08 probe used Debug.game_state.god and therefore cannot serve as native runtime proof; the probe implementation and result classification were corrected.
issues.impact: The historical owner transition is audit context only and cannot close the native AI ally gate.
issues.nextAction: Do not reuse the debug-assisted artifact as a pass; require a fresh debug-free runtime window.

issues.summary: Patched launcher readiness is stable, but the 18166 follow-up raw websocket closed before probe completion.
issues.impact: The launcher readiness claim is usable, but the incomplete websocket run cannot prove gameplay behavior.
issues.nextAction: Rerun a fresh compliant native probe when the runtime window is available and retain blocked status until it completes.

issues.summary: The outer PowerShell command used for the 18204 runtime probe did not propagate the probe's expected nonzero blocked exit code, although the structured artifact was written and validated.
issues.impact: A wrapper exit code alone could be misread as success or failure; the artifact verdict must remain authoritative until the wrapper is corrected.
issues.nextAction: Invoke the probe directly or explicitly propagate `$LASTEXITCODE` in the runtime wrapper on the next probe.

issues.summary: A fresh approved-launcher run on port 18220 reached ready and CreateGame=init_game, but JoinGame timed out after 120 seconds before any playable observation.
issues.impact: This window cannot prove gameplay progression, P2 ownership, or a ScriptError-free in-game handover; it is not promoted to a native AI ally pass.
issues.nextAction: Retry with a fresh runtime lease when JoinGame completes; retain the prior 18204 debug-free blocked gameplay evidence as the latest completed native census.

issues.summary: The RO adapter previously had no explicit lifecycle boundary for allies whose units are handed over after a mission trigger.
issues.impact: Callers can now distinguish static P1 command authorization from runtime P2 readiness; pre-handover dispatch is rejected without changing map-owned behavior.
issues.nextAction: Keep the native runtime gate separate and require a fresh no-debug handover observation before enabling thorner03 P2 actions.
